✨ Good Food, Great Company & Beautiful Connections!

A lovely visit from the wonderful Indian women of London and the UK, who joined us all the way from Richmond at The Sixth Element! ❤️

Bringing people together over delicious modern Indian cuisine, delightful brunches, fine wines and amazing cocktails — because the best memories are always made around the table. 🥂🍛

Thank you for visiting us and making your time at The Sixth Element so special. We look forward to welcoming you again soon! ✨

📍 The Sixth Element – Your place for great food, great drinks and even greater company.

🥃 Five countries. Five whiskeys. One unforgettable evening.
What a night at Sixth Sense as we took our guests on a whiskey journey around the world 🌎

🇯🇵 Japan • 🇮🇳 India • 🇦🇺 Australia • 🇺🇸 Kentucky • 🇮🇪 Ireland

From bold and smoky to smooth and complex, each pour brought its own character, story, and flavour to the table.

A celebration of great whiskey, good company, and unforgettable moments. 🥃✨

Thank you to everyone who joined us for the journey. Until the next pour…
